gold_text: Given a known customer and at least one order item that refers to an existing product, When the order is submitted with a payment method, Then the system registers an order with the submission date as its order date and the status submitted.
gen_text: Given a known customer, when the customer submits an order with at least one order item referencing existing products and a valid payment method, then the system creates an order with status submitted, order date = submission date, and total amount = Σ(quantity × unitPrice).

gold_text: Given an order with the status submitted, When OrderStaff receives the order, Then the system sets its status to pending.
gen_text: Given an order with status submitted, when OrderStaff receives the order, then the system changes the status to pending.

gold_text: Given an order with the status pending, When OrderStaff marks the order as filled, Then the system sets its status to filled.
gen_text: Given a pending order, when OrderStaff marks it as filled, then the system changes the status to filled.

gold_text: Given an order whose status is not pending, When OrderStaff attempts to mark the order as filled, Then the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged.
gen_text: Given a pending order, when OrderStaff marks it as filled, then the system changes the status to filled.
note: Gold is a rejection case while generated criterion specifies the successful case

gold_text: Given an order with the status pending, When OrderStaff declines the order, Then the system sets its status to closed.
gen_text: Given a pending order, when OrderStaff declines it, then the system changes the status to closed.

gold_text: Given an order with the status filled, When OrderStaff marks the order as shipped, Then the system sets its status to shipped.
gen_text: Given a filled order, when OrderStaff ships the order, then the system changes the status to shipped.
note: Same filled-to-shipped transition, although the wording is kinda wrong

gold_text: Given an order whose status is not filled, When OrderStaff attempts to mark the order as shipped, Then the system rejects the request and leaves the status unchanged.
gen_text: Given a filled order, when OrderStaff ships the order, then the system changes the status to shipped.
note: Gold is a rejection case while generated criterion specifies the successful case

gold_text: Given an order whose status is filled or shipped and that has no invoice, When the Accountant issues an invoice for the order, Then the system records an invoice with a date, a decimal amount, a payment method and the status issued.
gen_text: Given a filled (or shipped) order with no invoice, when Accountant raises an invoice with date, amount, payment method and status issued, then the system creates the invoice linked to the order.

gold_text: Given an invoice with the status issued, When the Customer submits a payment against the invoice with a date, an amount and a payment method, Then the system records the payment with the status pending.
gen_text: Given an issued invoice, when a Customer submits a payment with date, amount and payment method, then the system creates a payment with status pending linked to the invoice.

gold_text: Given an order with the status shipped whose invoice has the status paid, When OrderStaff closes the order, Then the system sets its status to closed.
gen_text: Given a shipped order whose linked invoice has status paid, when OrderStaff closes the order, then the system changes the order status to closed.
